about.title: About FYRO
about.body: FYRO — Find Your Right One — is an on-demand logistics marketplace launching in Andhra Pradesh. We connect customers who need cargo moved or loaded with verified truck drivers and Hamali labor, matched in real time, tracked live, at a fixed fare shown upfront.

fare.a: A base fare plus a per-kilometre rate for the route, with a guaranteed minimum — set per region and vehicle/Hamali category. You see the full breakdown and total before you confirm a booking, and it doesn't change after you do.

payment.a: FYRO shows you the fixed fare upfront. Payment is settled directly with your driver or Hamali team at the end of the job — there's no surprise afterward, since the amount was fixed from the moment you booked.

cancel.a: Yes, any time before it's marked completed. There's no cancellation fee — go to the booking's tracking page and use "Cancel booking."

coverage.a: Across Andhra Pradesh, expanding district by district — see the full list on the homepage. If you book outside an active district, you'll be told plainly rather than left waiting on a match that will never come.

accountability.a: A pickup and delivery photo attached to every job, live location while it's in progress, and a rating both sides give right after — mandatory before either can start their next job. See the Trust & Safety page for the full list.

noAccept.q: What if no one accepts my booking?
noAccept.a: You'll see it plainly on the tracking screen — FYRO doesn't fake a match. If nothing nearby is available, widen your pickup point or try again shortly as more workers come online.

mutha.a: A Mutha is a registered group of Hamali workers with one leader. For jobs that need multiple hands, a Mutha leader receives the request on behalf of the group and assigns members — including splitting one group across more than one job at once.

issue.q: What if something goes wrong during a job?
issue.a: Use "Report an issue" on the booking's tracking page — no-shows, damage, payment disputes, or misconduct go straight to our team as a complaint logged against that specific job.

customers.title: For customers
customers.body: Post a booking with pickup/drop points and cargo details, or request Hamali labor for loading and unloading — or bundle both. Nearby drivers and Hamali workers are offered your job one at a time, so you always get a real acceptance, not a fake instant match. Track your assigned driver or team live on the map, chat in-app, and pay the fixed fare you saw upfront when the job is done.

drivers.title: For drivers
drivers.body: Go online and receive job requests matched to your vehicle capacity and location. Accept or reject within a visible countdown. Follow a clear status stepper from pickup to delivery, and track your earnings and incentives in one place.

hamaliWorkers.title: For Hamali workers
hamaliWorkers.body: Work solo, or as part of a Mutha (labor group). Solo workers accept jobs directly. Mutha leaders receive requests on behalf of their group and assign members — even splitting one group across multiple job sites at once.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Illustrative Andhra Pradesh rate card. Final fare is calculated per booking based on distance, cargo, and live demand, and shown in full before you confirm.

safety.title: Trust & safety
safety.subtitle: What actually protects you on FYRO — every item below is a feature already running in the product, not a promise for later.

cancelWithoutPenalty.title: Cancel without penalty
cancelWithoutPenalty.body: Change your mind any time before a job is marked completed and cancel it — no fee, and you don't owe an explanation.

photoProof.title: Photo proof at pickup and delivery
photoProof.body: Drivers and Hamali workers attach a photo before they can advance a job past pickup, and again before marking it delivered — a real record attached to the booking, not just a status label.

twoWayRatings.title: Two-way ratings, every job
twoWayRatings.body: Customers rate their driver or Hamali team, and workers rate the customer, right after each job — it's mandatory before either side can start their next one, so the rating history you see is genuinely complete, not a self-selected sample.

liveLocation.title: Live location while a job is in progress
liveLocation.body: Once a driver or Hamali worker marks a job "in transit," their location streams to your tracking screen in real time until delivery — you're never guessing where your shipment is.

inAppChat.title: In-app chat, no raw numbers shared
inAppChat.body: Coordinate pickup details through the booking's in-app chat. FYRO doesn't hand your phone number to the other side, or theirs to you.

reportIssue.title: Report an issue on any booking
reportIssue.body: Every booking has a "Report an issue" action that opens a complaint straight to our team — no-shows, damage, payment disputes, or misconduct, logged against that specific job.

terms.title: Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the FYRO logistics platform. These documents define your rights and responsibilities.

userResponsibilities.heading: 01. User Responsibilities
userResponsibilities.body1: By creating an account or using the FYRO platform, you agree to provide accurate booking, vehicle, and identity details, and to conduct every pickup, delivery, and labor job in accordance with applicable local and state regulations.
userResponsibilities.body2: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential. Any activity under your account, authorized or not, remains your responsibility until you notify FYRO support of a suspected breach.

liability.heading: 02. Liability
liability.body1: FYRO connects customers with independent drivers and Hamali workers; it does not itself own vehicles or employ workers. Fares shown before you confirm a booking are final for that job, but FYRO is not a party to the underlying transport or labor contract.
liability.body2: To the extent permitted by law, FYRO is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from a delay, cancellation, or dispute between a customer and a driver or Hamali worker — use "Report an issue" on the booking to escalate any problem to our team.

dataPrivacy.heading: 03. Data Privacy
dataPrivacy.body1: We collect the location, booking, and account data needed to match you with a driver or Hamali worker, show live tracking, and process ratings. Data in transit and at rest is protected using industry-standard encryption.
dataPrivacy.note: FYRO never sells your individual booking or location data to third parties. Aggregated, anonymized data may be used to improve matching and route quality.

governingLaw.heading: 04. Governing Law
governingLaw.body1: These Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are governed by the laws of India, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
governingLaw.body2: Any dispute arising from these terms shall be resolved exclusively in the competent courts of Andhra Pradesh.

terms.acknowledgment: By continuing to use the FYRO platform, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these terms.
